location_note: Diskin Street, Jerusalem, found in 1995 during sewer-line works; map ref. NIG 22004/63180, OIG 17004/13180.
notes: Rock-cut burial cave: chamber L100 with standing pit, one kokh in the south-east wall and three in the north-east wall, plastered shelf, side chamber L106 with one kokh used as a collecting room; ten ossuaries (some inscribed; Reich contribution) and 23 individuals; disturbed or robbed.

features.subtype: kokhim burial cave with standing pit, side collecting chamber and ten ossuaries
